I THINK TRADITIONS CAN CARRY ACCUMULATED WISDOM WORTH PRESERVING, SO THEY HAVE SOME VALUE, THOUGH NOT UNCONDITIONAL VALUE.
I STRONGLY SUPPORT INTERNATIONAL SCIENTIFIC COLLABORATION AS IT ACCELERATES PROGRESS AND ADDRESSES CHALLENGES THAT CROSS BORDERS.
